title: Successful Visit, New Client
full_transcript: Good morning, I'm here to follow up on our proposal from last week. Yes, come in. We had a chance to review it. Great. Any questions on the pricing structure? Not really. We'd like to move forward with the starter package. Perfect. I'll send the contract by Thursday. We can onboard you by end of month. That works for us.
transcript_summary: Deal closed. Client agreed to starter package. Contract to be sent by Thursday. Onboarding end of month.
action_items: Send contract by Thursday
Onboard client by end of month

title: Price Objection
full_transcript: So based on your team size, I'd recommend the professional plan at 400 euros per month. That's more than we expected, honestly. I understand. What budget range were you thinking? Somewhere around 250. Let me check if we can offer a quarterly discount. I'll come back to you by Wednesday.
transcript_summary: Client found professional plan at 400 euros too expensive. Budget is around 250 euros. Salesperson to follow up with discount proposal.
action_items: Check if quarterly discount is possible
Follow up by Wednesday with discount proposal

title: Decision Maker Not Present
full_transcript: I wanted to discuss the integration options with your team today. Unfortunately our IT lead couldn't make it. He's out until next week. No problem. Can we schedule a call for Monday with him included? Yes, Monday at 10 should work.
transcript_summary: IT lead was absent. Meeting rescheduled to Monday at 10am with IT lead included.
action_items: Reschedule meeting to Monday 10am
Include IT lead in next meeting

title: Competitor Mention
full_transcript: How has your current solution been working for you? It's okay. We're also looking at what Salesforce offers. Fair enough. Our advantage is the voice-first workflow, no manual data entry after visits. That does sound interesting. Can you show me a demo? Absolutely. I'll set up a live demo for next Tuesday.
transcript_summary: Client is evaluating Salesforce as alternative. Interested in voice-first workflow differentiator. Demo scheduled for Tuesday.
action_items: Schedule live demo for Tuesday

title: Follow-up After Trial
full_transcript: You've been on the trial for two weeks now. How's it going? The team likes it but we had some issues with the mobile app crashing. I'll escalate that to our technical team today. Have you been using the voice logging feature? Not yet, we haven't had training on it. I'll arrange a 30-minute onboarding session for your team this week.
transcript_summary: App crash issue escalate to tech. Voice feature not used yet. Onboarding session this week.
action_items: Escalate app crash issue to technical team today
Arrange 30-minute onboarding session this week

title: Cold Visit, Receptive Client
full_transcript: Hi, I know this is unannounced but I work with field sales teams in this area. Do you have five minutes? Sure, why not. We help sales reps log customer visits automatically using voice. No typing, no forms. Interesting. Our reps spend a lot of time on admin after visits. Exactly the problem we solve. Can I send you some materials? Yes, send it to my email, m.hoffman at bauer-gruppe dot de.
transcript_summary: Cold visit. Receptive. Send materials to m.hoffman@bauer-gruppe.de.
action_items: Send product materials to m.hoffman@bauer-gruppe.de

title: Renewal Discussion
full_transcript: Your annual contract is up in six weeks. Have you thought about renewal? We have, yes. We're happy overall but want to add two more user seats. That's easy to do. I can add seats to the renewal quote. Also, is there any loyalty discount? For two-year renewals we offer 15 percent. I'll include both options in the quote.
transcript_summary: Renewal in 6 weeks. Client wants 2 extra seats. Offer 1yr and 2yr quote with loyalty discount.
action_items: Add 2 extra seats to renewal quote
Send 1-year and 2-year renewal options with loyalty discount

title: Technical / GDPR Concern
full_transcript: Ready to proceed with the rollout? Almost. Our data team has questions about GDPR compliance and where data is stored. All data is stored on EU servers. I can send our compliance documentation. Please do. Also, do you have an ISO certification? We're ISO 27001 in progress. Expected Q3. I'll send what we have now.
transcript_summary: Client raised GDPR compliance and data storage questions. ISO 27001 certification in progress for Q3. Compliance docs to be sent.
action_items: Send GDPR compliance documentation
Share current ISO 27001 status

title: Unhappy Client
full_transcript: I wanted to check in after the issues last month. Honestly, we were quite frustrated. The system was down for two days. I completely understand and I apologize. That's been fixed and we've added redundancy. We need guarantees this won't happen again before we consider expanding. Fair. I'll send an updated SLA with uptime guarantees by end of week.
transcript_summary: Client unhappy due to downtime. Send updated SLA with uptime guarantee. Expansion on hold until resolved.
action_items: Send updated SLA with uptime guarantees by end of week

title: Upsell Opportunity
full_transcript: How many reps are currently using the platform? About twelve. But we have a new team of eight joining next quarter. We have a team scaling package that would cover all twenty at a better per-seat rate. What's the difference in price? Instead of 40 euros per seat you'd pay 32. I'll send a comparison sheet.
transcript_summary: 12 current users. 8 joining next quarter. Upsell team scaling package at 32 euros per seat. Send comparison.
action_items: Send pricing comparison sheet for team scaling package

title: Deal Lost — Budget Cuts
full_transcript: Thanks for making time. Have you had a chance to review the proposal? We have, and we've decided to go in a different direction. Can I ask what made the difference? Mostly internal budget cuts. Nothing to do with your product. I understand. Can I check back in next quarter? Sure, that's fine.
transcript_summary: Deal lost due to budget cuts. Not a product issue. Follow up next quarter.
action_items: Follow up next quarter

title: Pilot Proposal
full_transcript: Rather than committing to the full rollout, would a pilot work for you? What would that look like? Five users, 60 days, with full support. You pay nothing until you decide to scale. That sounds reasonable. Let me confirm with my director. Of course. I'll send the pilot agreement so you have something concrete to show him.
transcript_summary: Pilot proposed — 5 users, 60 days, free of charge. Client confirming with director. Pilot agreement to be sent.
action_items: Send pilot agreement document
Wait for director confirmation

title: ASR Domain Term Issue
full_transcript: How is the platform working for your team in Frankfurt? Is working good but some words, technical words, the system is not understanding correct. That's useful feedback. Which terms specifically? Like product codes. For example KFZ-Zulassung or Rahmenvertrag. Got it. I'll pass those to our ASR team to improve recognition for those terms.
transcript_summary: German domain terms not recognized. KFZ-Zulassung and Rahmenvertrag reported to ASR team.
action_items: Report unrecognized terms to ASR team: KFZ-Zulassung, Rahmenvertrag

title: Multi-Site Enterprise Client
full_transcript: You mentioned you have offices in three cities? Yes, Berlin, Hamburg, and München. Do your sales reps work across sites or are they based locally? Each city has its own team. About 15 reps each. So we're talking about 45 seats total. I can offer a multi-site enterprise plan. Send me the details and I'll loop in our procurement team.
transcript_summary: 3 offices — Berlin, Hamburg, München. 45 seats total. Send enterprise plan. Loop in procurement.
action_items: Send enterprise plan details
Loop in procurement team

title: Demo Follow-up — CRM Integration
full_transcript: You saw the demo last week. What did your team think? They liked the voice logging but weren't sure about the CRM integration with our system. Which CRM are you using? HubSpot. We have a native HubSpot integration. I'll set up a technical call with our engineer.
transcript_summary: Team liked voice logging. HubSpot integration concern. Schedule technical call with engineer.
action_items: Schedule technical call with engineer about HubSpot integration

title: Onboarding Pushed to January
full_transcript: I know Q4 is busy for your team. Would it make sense to onboard in January instead? Honestly yes. December is terrible for us. Let's lock in January 8th as the kickoff date then. I'll hold the slot. Perfect. Send me a calendar invite.
transcript_summary: Onboarding postponed to January 8th due to Q4 pressure. Calendar invite to be sent.
action_items: Send calendar invite for January 8th onboarding kickoff

title: Reference Request
full_transcript: Would it help to speak with one of our existing customers in your industry? Actually yes. Do you have anyone in logistics? We have two clients in logistics. I'll ask if one of them is open to a reference call. That would be very helpful. I'll come back to you by Friday with a contact.
transcript_summary: Client wants reference in logistics. Check with 2 existing logistics clients. Respond by Friday.
action_items: Contact 2 logistics clients about reference call
Respond to client with contact by Friday

title: Feature Requests
full_transcript: Any feedback from the team after month one? Overall positive. One thing, can the summary be exported directly to PDF? Not currently but that's been requested before. I'll log it as a feature request. Also, can we customize the fields in the visit report? Custom fields are on our roadmap for Q2. I'll add you to the beta list.
transcript_summary: Feature requests — PDF export and custom report fields. Log both. Add client to Q2 beta list.
action_items: Log PDF export as feature request
Add client to Q2 custom fields beta list

title: Budget Approval Pending
full_transcript: Any update on the budget approval? Still waiting. Finance meets next Thursday. Understood. Should I follow up with you on Friday then? Yes, Friday afternoon is good. I'll also send a one-page summary you can share with the finance team.
transcript_summary: Budget pending. Finance decision Thursday. Follow up Friday afternoon. Send one-pager for finance.
action_items: Send one-pager summary for finance team
Follow up Friday afternoon after finance meeting

title: Short Rushed Visit
full_transcript: I know you're about to head out. I'll keep this quick. Yes sorry, I have a call in five minutes. No problem. Just wanted to confirm you received the updated pricing. I did, looks good. Let's talk properly on Wednesday. Wednesday it is. I'll send a meeting link.
transcript_summary: Short visit. Client confirmed receipt of updated pricing. Full meeting Wednesday. Send meeting link.
action_items: Send meeting link for Wednesday
